svg.title: Measured pre-boot MFD TEST_MODE contrast
svg.desc: Four fresh TEST_MODE0 probes without software pulses yielded seventeen flat sequential raw Y/C observations each. A repeated Y332/C408; B repeated Y688/C612. A′ and B′ matched their original raw series exactly. Previous TEST_MODE8 HSIZE4 probes yielded eight changing observations, ending with PICTURE_SYNC LAST_PIXEL at ordinal7. The comparison does not establish accepted transfers, autonomous fetch bounds, a source lease, routing or processing completion.

g.text: Packed MFD: TEST_MODE0 versus the pulsed profile
BCM70015 · isolated pre-CMAC experiment · four fresh probes: A, B, A′, B′ · staged firmware was never booted
Mode contrast from #231: TEST_MODE8 → 0; omit every W9/W8 host pulse pair. Sole START; no SCL writes.
Same empirical geometry phases (0x780,0x436) → (4,0x436) → (4,1), LINE0=0, STRIDE0 and CTRL5; not reset-default or unit proof.
Same 96-byte prefix: 16 reference bytes + 80 padding bytes. Checked MASTER0 is NOT a local-DDR fetch bound.
Observation ordinal — NOT elapsed time or accepted transfers

g.text: Normal samples match reference pair index2 ×4: A Y332/C408, B Y688/C612. Flat samples do not establish a transfer sequence.
Normal: READY1 / ACCEPT0, FEED.LINE_COUNT2, LAST_LINE0, EOL0, EOF0, feeder-error bits0 in all 68 raw bundles.
A′=A and B′=B raw series exactly. No LAST/EOF was sampled in the normal profile; each diagnostic remains INCONCLUSIVE.
Four intentional pre-CMAC aborts: download20/status−5, stock cleanup0, retained=false, no firmware commands.
Six separate native controls PASS: five MPEG-2 + one H.264, each full 180 frames, canonical full pixels, EOS and resources.
Sequential observations are not atomic snapshots. The 96-byte prefix is NOT a source extent or autonomous-read limit.
Pulse/handshake semantics, source namespace/units/runtime lease, accepted sink output, routing and completion remain unproved.
